$comment: D4.44. Two realistic term-sheet intakes for the rebuild's regression tests.
complete: every choice answered. open: every optional choice left unanswered, a non-resident investor and CCDs, so the open points, the FEMA text and the Section 71(1) text are exercised.

complete.conversion_terms: 1:1, adjusted for anti-dilution, converting on the earlier of a qualified IPO and the 19th anniversary of issue
complete.use_of_funds: product development, hiring and working capital
complete.option_pool_timing: Created after the investment (dilutes all shareholders, including the Investor)
complete.board_structure: three directors: two nominated by the Founders and one by the Investor
complete.reserved_matters: issuing new securities, borrowing above Rs. 50,00,000, changing the business, and any sale of the Company
complete.founder_vesting: four years with a one-year cliff, starting from completion
complete.transfer_restrictions: Investor right of first refusal and tag-along; Founder lock-in for three years
complete.conditions_precedent: assignment of all Founder intellectual property relating to the business to the Company
